title: PR146 candidate unmatched outputs: agent-assisted visual observations
numbering: candidate_prediction_number is the one-based position in the PR146 candidate postclip output list and is displayed as outNNN. primary_prediction_id is copied from inventory prediction.primary_prediction_id and is displayed as primary PNNN. These identifiers can differ after clipping/filtering; neither is a historical-model P-ID.

taxonomy.front_extent_or_fragment: Visible cassette-front material contributes to the response, but the predicted extent fragments or mixes the front, neighbor, or occluder. This includes physical repeat responses below the formal duplicate threshold; it is not a certified label error.
taxonomy.rack_or_gripper: Support rail or gripper appearance dominates the response. This is a provisional visual interpretation, not an automatic dataset edit.
taxonomy.keyboard_or_other_background: The response is on keyboard/accessory/other background away from the cassette rack.
taxonomy.reference_policy_exclusion: The response overlaps a documented, explicitly excluded historical front. Some boxes also include retained material or an occluder; the count is policy-sensitive overlap, not proof that exclusion alone caused the unmatched output.
taxonomy.ambiguous_partial_fragment: The available pixels do not confidently distinguish a front fragment from another cassette surface, rack, or gripper.
taxonomy.formal_duplicate: Computational duplicate from the fixed matcher, retained as a separate category; the observation describes visible content without certifying the reference.

limitations: All 112 raw/overlay pairs were visually reviewed. Wider full originals were inspected for the 11 images named above; this does not certify all image annotations or full-scene completeness.

The mutually exclusive subtype is the primary visual interpretation. A box can contain both a true front and an occluder, so categories are not physical segmentation masks or proven causal mechanisms.
The 23 formal duplicates are computational matcher outcomes copied unchanged from the inventory. The remaining 89 unmatched outputs are not automatically background.
Qualitative high/moderate/low confidence is not a calibrated probability. Exact replacement coordinates, hidden corners, or new object identities are not supplied.
Explicit R38-era exclusions of R37 rows remain in force. Overlap with an excluded row is recorded without reinsertion, and visible partial material is not declared verified background.
No label file, prediction, threshold, matcher decision, or model was changed by this review.
